    Simulated RNA-seq counts and gene sets

    Source: R/data.R
    expression_sim.Rd

    Simulated data. expression_sim holds negative binomial read counts for 1000 genes in 8 samples (4 control, 4 stress) with random library sizes. Genes gene_0001 to gene_0050 are truly up-regulated under stress (log2 fold change 1 to 3), gene_0051 to gene_0075 truly down-regulated and the rest unchanged. gene_sets_sim holds 30 gene sets in long format: stress_response (30 up-regulated genes and 10 unchanged ones), repressed_metabolism (15 down-regulated and 15 unchanged) and 28 random background sets.

    Usage

    expression_sim

gene_sets_sim

    Format

    expression_sim is a tibble with 8000 rows and 4 columns:

    gene

    Gene identifier.

    sample

    Sample identifier.

    condition

    "control" or "stress".

    count

    Read count.

    gene_sets_sim is a tibble with columns gene_set and feature.

    An object of class tbl_df (inherits from tbl, data.frame) with 1081 rows and 2 columns.

    Source

    Simulated with a fixed seed in data-raw/make_data.R.

    Examples

    expression_sim
#> # A tibble: 8,000 × 4
#>    gene      sample condition count
#>    <chr>     <chr>  <chr>     <dbl>
#>  1 gene_0001 S01    control     316
#>  2 gene_0002 S01    control     221
#>  3 gene_0003 S01    control    1584
#>  4 gene_0004 S01    control    1635
#>  5 gene_0005 S01    control    2086
#>  6 gene_0006 S01    control    2513
#>  7 gene_0007 S01    control    2105
#>  8 gene_0008 S01    control     111
#>  9 gene_0009 S01    control     491
#> 10 gene_0010 S01    control     120
#> # ℹ 7,990 more rows
gene_sets_sim
#> # A tibble: 1,081 × 2
#>    gene_set        feature  
#>    <chr>           <chr>    
#>  1 stress_response gene_0002
#>  2 stress_response gene_0015
#>  3 stress_response gene_0008
#>  4 stress_response gene_0036
#>  5 stress_response gene_0047
#>  6 stress_response gene_0025
#>  7 stress_response gene_0040
#>  8 stress_response gene_0034
#>  9 stress_response gene_0032
#> 10 stress_response gene_0022
#> # ℹ 1,071 more rows
